spec.description:
**A worked example, small enough to read in one sitting.**

Three blocks, one flow, one saved request and one suite — a person
drops a parcel into a locker and the ledger learns about it.

Nothing here is a real system. What is real is the *shape*: every file in
this design is byte-for-byte what the emitter renders, which is what makes
the directory usable as a fixture as well as an example.
